summary.name: Kimi API Model List
summary.one_liner: Moonshot AI's Kimi API platform page listing its multimodal models and the deprecation and migration status of older Kimi models.
use_cases: Checking which Kimi API model is currently supported
Planning migration away from deprecated Kimi or Moonshot models
Finding a multimodal model with vision and thinking modes
Looking up Kimi model retirement dates
summary.what_it_does: The page lists Kimi's currently available multimodal and coding models, with the flagship kimi-k2.5 named in the listing as supporting vision, thinking and non-thinking modes, and agent use. It is mainly a deprecation notice: it states that kimi-k2.5, the moonshot-v1 series, the kimi-k2 series, kimi-latest and kimi-thinking-preview have been discontinued and are no longer maintained. Each discontinued entry points users to kimi-k3.1-pro as the replacement. It also says the K2 series will no longer be available to newly registered users from October 31, 2026, with full retirement planned by the end of December 2026. The page text does not give pricing figures or detailed model specifications.
notable: Lists deprecated Kimi and Moonshot models with discontinuation dates and replacement guidance
Recommends kimi-k3.1-pro as the replacement for all discontinued models
K2 series retirement timeline: unavailable to new users from October 31, 2026, fully retired by end of December 2026
caveats: kimi-k2.5 and moonshot-v1 models were discontinued on August 31, 2026 and are no longer supported
The K2 series is being retired; existing users are not affected until the planned retirement
Pricing details are not included in the page text; users are directed to sales for further assistance
